focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期临近，中国出口企业需紧急核查产品碳足迹
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起全面征收碳关税。涉及钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢等产品的中国出口企业，须在2026年10月前完成产品碳足迹核算、申报及供应链数据收集。未合规申报可能面临罚款及市场准入限制。建议企业立即启动碳数据管理，并考虑在欧盟设立实体或与当地进口商合作以降低合规成本。
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transition Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Verify Product Carbon Footprints
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transition period ends in late 2026, with full carbon tariffs applying from 2027. Chinese exporters of steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity, and hydrogen must complete product carbon footprint calculations, declarations, and supply chain data collection by October 2026. Non-compliance may result in fines and market access restrictions. Companies should immediately initiate carbon data management and consider establishing an EU entity or partnering with local importers to reduce compliance costs.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认中国法院商事判决，跨境执行路径进一步畅通
case.summary: 近期，新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）在一起中资企业合同纠纷中，依据《选择法院协议公约》及中新司法合作备忘录，承认并执行了中国法院的商事判决。该案明确了中国判决在普通法系国家的可执行性，为出海企业选择中国法院管辖提供了信心。实务中，企业应确保合同包含排他性管辖条款，并保留完整的送达与证据链，以便在境外申请承认与执行。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭 · 2026.09
case.title_en: SICC Recognises Chinese Commercial Judgment, Paving Way for Cross-Border Enforcement
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised and enforced a Chinese court's commercial judgment in a contractual dispute involving a Chinese company, based on the Hague Choice of Court Convention and the China-Singapore judicial cooperation memorandum. The case confirms the enforceability of Chinese judgments in common law jurisdictions, giving exporters confidence to choose Chinese courts. In practice, companies should include exclusive jurisdiction clauses and maintain proper service and evidence records for overseas enforcement.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境数据流动便利化措施，涉外企业数据合规迎来新指引
policy.summary: 2026年10月，广东省与香港、澳门相关部门联合发布《粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化指引》，允许符合条件的企业在金融、医疗、贸易等领域进行数据跨境传输，并简化安全评估流程。指引明确了数据分类分级、个人信息保护及出境白名单机制。大湾区企业应借此优化数据合规体系，利用便利化通道降低合规成本，同时关注行业-specific要求。
policy.source: 来源：广东省政务服务数据管理局 · 2026.10
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Introduces Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation Measures, New Guidance for Foreign-Related Enterprises
policy.summary_en: In October 2026, Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao authorities jointly issued the Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation Guidelines, permitting eligible enterprises in finance, healthcare, and trade to transfer data across borders with simplified security assessment procedures. The guidelines clarify data classification, personal information protection, and an outbound whitelist mechanism. GBA enterprises should optimise their data compliance frameworks, leverage facilitation channels to reduce costs, and monitor sector-specific requirements.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Government Services and Data Management Bureau · 2026.10

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规下，中国企业的合规策略与应对
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部2026年9月发布的对外投资审查最终规则，将半导体、人工智能、量子计算等领域的对华投资纳入禁止或申报范围。中国企业应重新评估跨境投资架构，避免通过第三国规避审查；同时，在美子公司或合资企业需建立内部合规机制，对涉及敏感技术的交易进行尽职调查。建议企业提前与法律顾问沟通，利用豁免条款并准备申报材料，以降低交易受阻风险。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Compliance Strategies for Chinese Companies under New US Outbound Investment Review Rules
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury's final outbound investment review rules issued in September 2026 prohibit or require notification for investments in semiconductors, AI, and quantum computing involving China. Chinese companies should reassess cross-border investment structures to avoid circumvention via third countries. US subsidiaries or joint ventures must establish internal compliance mechanisms and conduct due diligence on sensitive technology transactions. Companies are advised to consult legal counsel early, utilise exemptions, and prepare filings to mitigate deal risks.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Department of the Treasury · 2026.09
